run_encode_many: run the encode_many script to batch-encode voxel shape pairs using an autoencoder model
run_encode_many_sbatch: run encode_many in sbatch cluster mode without visdom visualization for headless encoding
run_encode_many_color_io: run encode_many with color-alpha input mode for colored voxel shape encoding
run_encode_many_custom_model: run encode_many with a custom model filepath to encode shapes with a pre-trained autoencoder
run_encode_many_custom_workers: run encode_many with a custom number of dataloader workers for parallel data loading
